title: Pho Tacos
description: A fusion twist on traditional pho, served in a crispy taco shell. A delicious blend of Asian and Mexican flavors.
instructions: Cook the pho broth according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, cook the sliced beef over medium-high heat until browned.
Add the thinly sliced beef to the pan and cook until browned.
Add the broccoli to the pan and cook until tender.
Warm the taco shells according to package instructions.
Assemble the tacos by placing a portion of the beef and broccoli mixture into each shell.
Top with a spoonful of pho broth, a sprinkle of cilantro, and a dollop of sour cream.
Serve with a side of sriracha for added spice.
Optional: top with shredded cheese and additional cilantro.
